item.title: Volunteer fire department in Port Allen calling it quits after 90 years of service
item.description: PORT ALLEN - Members of a volunteer fire department, founded ninety years ago, say it's time to hang up their gear as the Port Allen Fire Department dwindles in numbers.Volunteers say there are plans to unveil a monument honoring generations of firefighters who volunteered their time to the city.When duty calls, the right people make all the difference, and for nearly 50 years, Barry Brewer has shown up for Port Allen. item.title: Price Leblanc gives away $70,000 to non-profit to celebrate 70th anniversary
item.description: BATON ROUGE - For its 70th anniversary, Price Leblanc is giving away $70,000 in both November and December to non-profits.In November, Blue Star Mothers of Louisiana was voted the winner via the community. The group supports mothers of veterans and children in the military.Permalink| Comments

item.title: Westdale Middle School closing tomorrow due to sewage issue
item.description: BATON ROUGE - Westdale Middle School will be closed on Friday, Dec. 5, due to a sewage issue, EBR Schools said.A sewage backup was reported near the campus, and when contractors responded, the problem was confirmed to be with the city's main sewer line and not within the school.Because repairs must be completed by municipal crews, the city could not guarantee the work will be finished by tomorrow morning. Officials said repairs are expected to be done with the school re-opening on Monday, Dec. 8

item.title: Baton Rouge City Constable questions proposed budget cuts
item.description: BATON ROUGE - Mayor Sid Edwards has emphasized public safety when discussing which departments would be facing budget cuts, but Constable Terrica Williams says her office also should not lose funding, as they is considered a law enforcement agency.Williams says from what she understood, law enforcement and first responders would not be impacted by the budget cuts. But, she says, she got a call from the city-parish finance department about a week ago stating their budget may be cut by 11 percent.

item.title: One Tank Trips: Monster Mini Golf
item.description: HAMMOND - On this week's One Tank Trips, one step through the doorway at this mini golf course takes out of Hammond into a realm where the glowing monsters are waiting to gauge whether your put put skills are scarier than they are.Monster Mini Golf turns the classic put put golf into a bright-eyed world of spooky fun; it was dreamed up by a dad who knows family entertainment more than anyone.Permalink| Comments
